errors.evidence: This part of the description contains two errors. First, it claims the line ends at its highest position, but the start position in 2016 is at the same height. Second, it describes the value as 'a little below 25.0', which is a significant overstatement; the value is approximately 23.8%, which is much closer to 24.0 than 25.0.
The description states the lowest point of the line in 2018 is 'close to 22.0', but the figure shows the point is exactly on the 22.0 grid line.
